units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 9:15:2">Y. Sot. IX, end, 24ᶜ</cite> [read:] <he>הוון בעון מִחְתַּנְתֵּיה לנסיותא</he>, they desired to ally him to the Nasi family; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 3:1:15">Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42ᶜ</cite> bot <he>הוון אילין … בעון מהיתנתיה</he> (read: <he>מִיחְתַּ׳</he>) members of the Nasi family desired to take him into the family.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 18:22">Targ. I Sam. XVIII, 22</cite>, sq.; a. fr.—Y. Sabb. XII, 13ᶜ bot. <he>אִיתְחַתְּנוּן וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="N01308"><he>נְשִׂיאוּתָא</he></cite>.
